title: Solar Rooftops Program
summary_short: Encouraging households to install solar panels.
intro_short: Homes around the world are turning to rooftop solar to offset electricity costs.
impact: Reduces fossil fuel dependency and promotes renewable energy.

title: Public Electric Bus Fleet
summary_short: Replacing diesel buses with electric ones.
intro_short: Cities are rapidly electrifying public transport systems.
impact: Cuts emissions and improves urban air quality.

title: Energy Efficient Building Retrofits
summary_short: Refitting buildings to use less power.
intro_short: Old buildings can save energy with smart retrofits like LED lighting and better insulation.
impact: Reduces energy bills and greenhouse gases.

title: Low-Carbon Cement Production
summary_short: Making cement with lower CO₂ emissions.
intro_short: Cement is a major source of industrial emissions.
impact: Helps decarbonize construction and infrastructure projects.

title: Vertical Farming for Cities
summary_short: Growing food indoors using less land and water.
intro_short: Vertical farming is a sustainable way to grow fresh food in urban areas.
impact: Uses 90% less water and eliminates transport emissions.
